blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multimodal agents use web and image tools to answer questions beyond their internal knowledge. Some search tasks use images mainly to identify an initial entity, then rely on text retrieval. These tasks offer limited insight into how agents connect information across images, objects, and search steps. We therefore focus on visual context management. This involves organizing and using visual information and linking it to other findings during search. Visually intensive tasks require agents to combine object appearance, local details, or spatial relations with external information. We introduce VisSearch-Bench, with 204 human-written tasks across 7 main domains and 25 subdomains. It covers Set-wise Visual Search, Sequential Visual Search, Hybrid Wide-Deep Search, Competitive Visual Disambiguation, and Visual-Structure-Guided Search. Each task provides a reference answer, traceable evidence, and scoring rules. Accuracy measures complete task success, while Process Score measures the correctness and completeness of individual results and subquestion answers. Across 16 multimodal models, the best system fully solves only 26.47% of tasks, even with search tools. These results highlight the challenge of linking visual evidence with search results to produce complete answers.
blocks.zh: 多式联运代理商使用网络和图像工具来回答超出其内部知识范围的问题. 一些搜索任务主要使用图像来识别初始实体,然后依靠文本检索. 这些任务对代理人如何在图像、物品和搜索步骤之间连接信息提供了有限的见解。 因此,我们侧重于视觉环境管理。 这涉及组织和使用视觉信息,并将其与其他搜索结果联系起来。 视觉密集的任务需要代理将对象外观,局部细节,或空间关系与外部信息相结合. 我们介绍VisSearch-Bench,它有204个人类写作的任务,涉及7个主要领域和25个子领域。 它涵盖Set-wise视觉搜索,序列视觉搜索,混合广深搜索,竞争性视觉分裂,以及视觉-结构-引导搜索. 每项任务都提供参考答案、可追踪证据和评分规则。 精确度测量完成任务成功,而过程分数测量单个结果和子问题答案的正确性和完整性. 在16个多式联运模式中,最好的系统完全解决了26.47%的任务,即使有搜索工具。 这些结果凸显了将视觉证据与搜索结果联系起来以产生完整答案的挑战.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are evolving from one-shot visual question answering systems into agents that can plan, use tools, and interact with the open web over multiple rounds ( Luo et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026b ) . With text search, image search, webpage browsing, and region-level image inspection, these systems can gather evidence beyond the initial prompt and solve complex information-seeking tasks ( Chng et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . This paradigm is closer to real-world information seeking than visual question answering based only on parametric knowledge.
blocks.zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)正在从一发可视问题回答系统演变为代理,能够计划,使用工具,并在多发回合中与开通网络进行互动(Luo等,2026;Wu等,2026b.). 通过文本搜索,图像搜索,网页浏览,以及地区层面的图像检查,这些系统可以收集到超过初始即时的证据并解决复杂的信息搜索任务(Chng等,2025;张等,2026b.). 这种范式更接近于寻求现实世界的信息,而不是仅仅基于参数化知识的视觉问题回答.

blocks.en:
At the same time, multimodal benchmarks are placing stronger demands on visual information. Models must not only understand images in the prompt, but also combine visual and textual evidence found during search ( Hou et al., 2026 ) . MMSearch-Plus ( Tao et al., 2026 ) emphasizes the extraction and propagation of fine-grained visual cues. MM-BrowseComp ( Li et al., 2025 ) and VisBrowse-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) require agents to actively obtain visual evidence while browsing.
Together, these benchmarks make visual evidence an active component of search.
blocks.zh:
同时,多式联运基准对视觉信息提出了更强烈的要求。 模型不仅要在即时理解图像,还要结合搜索过程中发现的视觉和文字证据(Hou等,2026. MMSearch-Plus(Tao等,2026年)强调取出并传播精致的视觉提示. MM-BrowseComp (Li等,2025年)和VisBrowse-Bench (Zhang等,2026c)要求特工在浏览时积极获取视觉证据.
这些基准共同使视觉证据成为搜索的一个活性组成部分.

blocks.en: However, existing multimodal search benchmarks often focus on whether visual evidence is used at some point in a task. How images are used can lead to different task demands. In some existing tasks, images mainly serve to identify an initial entity ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . Once the agent obtains the name of a person, object, or place, it can rely mainly on text search. Such tasks provide limited insight into how agents handle multiple images or connect visual information across search steps. More recent benchmarks involve more image searches and tool calls. However, higher counts alone do not imply more complex visual context. We also need to examine how these visual operations are connected and how they support later searches and the final answer.
blocks.zh: 然而,现有的多式搜索基准往往侧重于一项任务的某个时候是否使用了视觉证据。 如何使用图像会导致不同的任务需求. 在一些已存在的任务中,图像主要用于识别一个初始实体(Wang等,2023;Chen等,2026.). 一旦代理人获得一个人的名字,对象,或地点,可以主要依靠文本搜索. 这些任务对代理人如何处理多幅图像或将视觉信息连接到整个搜索步骤提供了有限的见解. 最近的基准涉及更多的图像搜索和工具呼叫。 然而,仅靠高点并不意味着视觉环境更为复杂。 我们还需要检查这些视觉操作是如何连接起来的,以及它们如何支持以后的搜索和最后的答案.

blocks.en: Real-world information seeking is more than a series of separate image recognition tasks ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . On the open web, agents need to update their understanding as they gather new evidence ( Yao et al., 2022 ) . Early evidence may suggest an initial hypothesis. Later evidence may help compare candidates, rule some out, or identify new ones. New information may also change how an earlier image is understood. An agent therefore needs to connect visual evidence across search steps and use it to guide further search ( Hu et al., 2023 ) . For example, finding all works in a catalog that meet a visual condition requires several steps. The agent must first establish the full set of entries, then inspect their images and combine the results. This raises a basic question: Can agents reliably organize and use visual evidence as it accumulates during open-web search?
blocks.zh: 求取真实世界信息不仅仅是一系列单独的图像识别任务(张等,2026b. ). 在公开的网络上,特工在收集新证据时需要更新他们的理解(姚等,2022.). 早期证据可能表明初步假设. 以后的证据可能有助于比较候选人,排除某些候选人,或确定新的候选人。 新信息也可能改变对更早的图像的理解. 因此,代理商需要将视觉证据连接到整个搜索步骤,并用它来指导进一步搜索(Hu等,2023年)。 例如,在符合视觉条件的目录中查找所有作品需要几个步骤. 代理商必须首先建立全套条目,然后检查他们的图像并综合结果. 这就提出了一个基本问题: 特工人员能否可靠地组织和使用在开放网络搜索过程中积累的视觉证据?

blocks.en: We use visual context management to describe how agents organize and use visual information and its connections to findings during search. We study this ability through tasks that involve multiple images, multiple objects, and linked search steps. We examine whether agents can connect visual observations with external information to compare objects, filter candidates, and follow clues. We also examine whether they can combine results across steps into a complete and consistent answer.
blocks.zh: 我们使用视觉上下文管理来描述代理如何组织和使用视觉信息及其在搜索过程中与发现的联系. 我们通过涉及多个图像、多个对象和链接搜索步骤的任务来研究这种能力。 我们检查代理人是否能够将视觉观测与外部信息相接,以比较对象,过滤候选人,并跟踪线索. 我们还审查它们是否能够把跨步骤的成果综合为一个完整和一致的答案。

blocks.en: To evaluate this ability, we introduce VisSearch-Bench , with five task categories that reflect different demands of long-horizon visual search. Set-wise Visual Search requires agents to collect and check visual information for a set of objects, then filter, compare, or combine the results. Sequential Visual Search uses visual clues from earlier steps to guide later searches. Hybrid Wide–Deep Search combines step-by-step search with search over a set of objects. Results from one stage determine the search scope or targets of another. Competitive Visual Disambiguation focuses on using fine visual details to distinguish similar-looking candidates. Visual-Structure-Guided Search combines object order, spatial positions, or connections in an image with information found through external search. Agents use this information to locate objects, check conditions, and combine results. Together, these tasks examine how agents handle multiple images, connect search results, and reason across steps. Figure 2 presents the five categories and representative tasks from different domains.
blocks.zh: 为了评价这种能力,我们引入了"VisSearch-Bench",有五个任务类别,反映了长视视觉搜索的不同需求. 即时可视化搜索需要代理来收集和检查一组对象的可视化信息,然后过滤,比较,或者合并结果. 序列可视化搜索使用从更早的步骤得到的视觉线索来指导后期搜索. Hybrid Wide-Deep Search将分步搜索和搜索结合起来,覆盖一组对象. 一个阶段的结果决定了另一个阶段的搜索范围或目标. 竞争性视觉歧见侧重于使用精细的视觉细节来区分相貌相近的候选人. Visual-Structure-Guided Search将对象顺序,空间位置,或图像中的连接与通过外部搜索发现的信息相融合. 特工们利用这些信息来定位对象,检查条件,并结合结果. 这些任务共同检查代理如何处理多幅图像,连接搜索结果,以及跨步骤的理性. 图2列出了来自不同领域的五个类别和代表性任务。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of VisSearch-Bench. The center presents five task families that require long-horizon visual search, while the surrounding panels show selected examples from the dataset across diverse content domains.
blocks.zh: 图2:VisSearch-Bench概览。 中心提出需要长视距视觉搜索的五个任务家庭,而周边的面板则显示不同内容域数据集中的某些实例.

blocks.en: VisSearch-Bench contains 204 human-written tasks across 7 main domains and 25 subdomains. Dataset construction is led by human annotators and supported by automated checks. Annotators build each task from public, searchable sources. They gather the required images, entity relationships, and facts, then write the question and reference answer. They also document the evidence supporting the solution. Automated checks and human review examine source accessibility, answer consistency, and possible shortcuts that bypass the intended visual requirements. For evaluation, we use Accuracy to measure whether the full answer meets the task requirements. We also use a task-specific Process Score to assess the correctness and completeness of individual results and answers to subquestions. Our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: VisSearch-Bench包含有跨越7个主要领域和25个子域的204个人文任务. 数据集建设由人名注释员领导,并辅以自动检查. 注释员从公开的,可搜索的来源构建出每个任务. 他们收集所需的图像,实体关系,以及事实,然后写出问题和参考答案. 他们还记录了支持解决办法的证据。 自动化检查和人文审查检查源的可访问性,回答一致性,以及绕过预期视觉要求的可能捷径. 对于评价,我们使用精确度来衡量完整的答案是否符合任务要求. 我们还利用具体任务进程得分评估各项结果的正确性和完整性以及对分问题的答复。 我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: 1. We introduce a task-based perspective for evaluating visual context management in open-web search. It focuses on how agents organize information from multiple images, connect different objects, and use visual findings to guide later searches. 2. We construct VisSearch-Bench , with 204 human-written tasks across 7 main domains and 25 subdomains. Its five categories cover Set-wise Visual Search, Sequential Visual Search, Hybrid Wide–Deep Search, Competitive Visual Disambiguation, and Visual-Structure-Guided Search. 3. We develop a human-led construction process supported by automated checks. Each task includes evidence sources, a reference answer, and scoring rules. Our evaluation combines full-answer accuracy with scores for individual results and subquestions. This measures overall task completion while also capturing which parts of an answer are correct or missing.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 我们采用了基于任务的观点,用于在开放式网络搜索中评价视觉环境管理。 它侧重于代理人如何从多幅图像中组织信息,连接不同的对象,并使用视觉发现来指导后期搜索. 2. 我们建造了VisSearch-Bench,在7个主要领域和25个子领域承担204个人文任务。 它的五个类别包括:Set-Wise视觉搜索,序列视觉搜索,Hybrid-Wide-Deep搜索,竞争性视觉分裂,和Visual-Structure-Guided搜索. 3. 我们开发了以自动化检查为后盾的由人主导的施工过程。 每项任务包括证据来源、参考答案和评分规则。 我们的评价将完全回答准确性与个别结果和分问题的分数结合起来。 这衡量总体任务完成情况,同时记录答案的哪些部分正确或缺失。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Vision-Language Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 远景-语言模式

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) combine visual information with language understanding ( Wu et al., 2026c ; Yu et al., 2026 ) . Their capabilities have expanded from single-image recognition and question answering to document reading, multi-image understanding, video analysis, and visual reasoning. InternVL3 ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) learns language and visual capabilities through joint pre-training and supports longer multimodal contexts. Kimi-VL ( Du et al., 2025 ) focuses on high-resolution images, multi-image understanding, and long-context reasoning. Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) supports interleaved text, image, and video inputs, with improvements in multimodal reasoning and spatial understanding. These advances provide a foundation for handling more varied and complex visual inputs.
blocks.zh: 视觉-语言模型(VLMs)将视觉信息与语言理解相结合(Wu等,2026c;Yu等,2026.). 他们的能力已经从单相识别和问答扩展到了文档读取,多相理解,视频分析和视觉推理. InternVL3(Zhu等,2025年)通过联合预训学习语言和视觉能力,并支持较长的多模式环境. Kimi-VL (Du et al., 2025) 专注于高分辨的图像,多图像的理解,以及长通文字推理. Qune3-VL(Bai等,2025年)支持互页文本,图像和视频输入,并改进了多模式推理和空间理解. 这些进展为处理更加多样和复杂的视觉投入奠定了基础。

blocks.en: Recent models further combine visual understanding with general reasoning, tool use, and multi-step task execution. Qwen3.5 ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) uses unified vision-language training and reinforcement learning to improve reasoning and agent capabilities. Later models, including Qwen3.6-35B-A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026c ) and Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026d ) , support image and video understanding. They also improve code generation and multi-step task execution. Visual understanding is thus becoming an important part of general-purpose agent models. It supports tasks such as interpreting charts, reading documents, and using information from user interfaces.
blocks.zh: 最近的模型进一步将视觉理解和一般推理,工具使用,以及多步骤的任务执行结合起来. Quen3.5 (Quen Team, 2026a.)使用统一的视觉语言培训和强化学习来提高推理和代理能力. 后期的型号,包括Qune3.6-35B-A3B(Quen Team,2026c)和Qune3.8-27B等. (Quen Team, 2026d.),支持图像和视频理解. 它们还改进了代码生成和多步任务执行. 因此,视觉理解正在成为通用剂模型的重要组成部分。 它支持诸如解释图表,阅读文档,以及使用用户界面的信息等任务.

blocks.en: Other model families follow a similar direction. GLM-5.3-Flash ( GLM-5-Team et al., 2026 ) introduces native multimodal capabilities to the GLM-5 series. It supports browser and computer use based on visual information. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ( Xu et al., 2026 ) supports both visual inputs and long-context reasoning. Kimi K3 ( Team et al., 2026a ) also provides native image and video understanding. Its one-million-token context window supports extended reasoning and tool interactions.
blocks.zh: 其他模范家庭也遵循类似的方向. GLM-5.3-Flash(GLM-5-Team等,2026年)向GLM-5系列引入了本土多模式能力. 它支持基于视觉信息的浏览器和计算机使用. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash(徐等,2026年)既支持视觉输入,也支持长文推理. Kimi K3(Team等,2026a)也提供本土形象和视频理解. 它的一百万个上下文窗口支持扩展推理和工具交互.

blocks.en: However, longer context windows do not guarantee effective visual-state management during search ( Wu et al., 2026b ) . In open-web search, agents also need to correctly match objects across images and connect visual observations with external facts. They must use earlier findings to determine later search targets. VisSearch-Bench therefore focuses on visual context management in tasks involving multiple images, multiple objects, and linked search steps. It evaluates whether agents can use these connections to verify objects, compare candidates, filter results, and combine findings across steps.
blocks.zh: 然而,较长的上下文窗口并不能保证搜索期间有效的视觉状态管理(Wu等,2026b.). 在开网搜索中,代理商还需要正确匹配跨图像的物体,并将视觉观测与外在事实相接. 他们必须使用更早的发现来确定后期的搜索目标. VisSearch-Bench因此在涉及多个图像,多个对象,以及链接搜索步骤的任务中,专注于视觉上下文管理. 它评价代理人是否能够利用这些连接来验证对象,比较候选人,过滤结果,并综合跨步骤的调查结果.

blocks.en: 2.2 Agentic Information Seeking
blocks.zh: 2.2 寻找代理信息

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks evaluate agentic information seeking through reasoning, tool use, and information gathering. GAIA focuses on multi-step reasoning and tool use in realistic tasks ( Mialon et al., 2023 ) . BrowseComp requires agents to persistently search the open web for facts that are difficult to find but easy to verify ( Wei et al., 2025 ) . WideSearch extends the focus to large-scale information gathering, emphasizing complete results that can be checked item by item ( Wong et al., 2025 ) . DeepWideSearch combines multi-hop retrieval with broad information collection to evaluate whether agents can handle both search depth and breadth ( Lan et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 现有基准评价通过推理、工具使用和信息收集寻求的代理信息。 GAIA专注于现实任务中的多步推理和工具使用(Mialon等,2023.). BurrowsComp要求代理商持续地搜索开放网络,寻找难以找到但易于核实的事实(Wei等,2025.). WideSearch将重点扩大到大规模的信息收集,强调可以逐项检查的完整结果(Wong等人,2025年). DeepWideSearch将多跳检索与广泛的信息收集结合起来,以评估代理商是否能够同时处理搜索深度和广度(Lan等,2025.).

blocks.en: Recent benchmarks place greater emphasis on answer coverage and information integration. DeepSearchQA ( Gupta et al., 2026 ) requires agents to follow linked search steps, gather information from different sources, and produce complete answer lists. GISA supports several answer formats, including individual items, sets, lists, and tables. It also provides human search trajectories to support process analysis and model training ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . DeepResearch Bench II ( Li et al., 2026 ) extends evaluation to long-form research reports. It uses detailed scoring criteria derived from expert reports to assess information coverage, analysis, and presentation.
blocks.zh: 最近的基准更加重视答复的覆盖面和信息的整合。 深搜索QA (Gupta等,2026年)需要代理跟踪链接的搜索步骤,从不同来源收集信息,并制作完整的答案列表. GISA支持几种答案格式,包括单个项目,集,列表和表格. 它还提供人类搜索轨迹以支持过程分析和模型培训(Zhu等,2026年). 深层研究 二等座(Li等,2026)将评价扩展到长式研究报告。 报告采用专家报告得出的详细评分标准来评估信息覆盖面、分析和列报。

blocks.en: Research on search methods also examines how agents organize evidence and adjust later search actions. SearchOS ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) maintains shared records of pending tasks, evidence, information coverage, and failed attempts. These records help coordinate multiple agents, fill information gaps, and reduce repeated unsuccessful searches. Further work uses search trajectories for supervised fine-tuning to connect retrieval decisions more closely with the reasoning process ( Chen et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 关于搜索方法的研究还审查了特工如何组织证据并调整以后的搜索行动. SearchOS (Zhang等, 2026b.) 保存了未完成的任务的共享记录,证据,信息覆盖,以及失败的尝试. 这些记录有助于协调多个代理,填补信息空白,并减少重复的不成功的搜索. 进一步的工作利用搜索轨迹进行有监督的微调,将检索决定与推理过程更紧密地联系起来(Chen等,2026.).

blocks.en: 2.3 Multimodal Search and Browsing
blocks.zh: 2.3 多式联运搜索和浏览

blocks.en: BrowseComp ( Wei et al., 2025 ) mainly evaluates text-based information seeking on the open web and provides a reference for assessing browsing capabilities. MMSearch ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) introduces image-text queries and evaluates query rewriting, result reranking, information summarization, and end-to-end answer generation. BrowseComp-VL ( Geng et al., 2025 ) combines visual recognition with complex web retrieval, requiring agents to conduct multi-step searches based on entities in images. Later benchmarks place greater emphasis on the role of visual evidence during search. MMSearch-Plus ( Tao et al., 2026 ) requires agents to extract fine-grained visual clues and verify related facts and sources through multiple rounds of image-text retrieval. VDR-Bench ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) focuses on reducing shortcuts based on textual clues and whole-image matching. It uses retrieval from image regions, entity verification, and multi-hop question construction to place greater demands on visual search. VisBrowse-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) emphasizes actively gathering visual information from webpages and evaluates spatial localization, attribute recognition, and reasoning across images.
blocks.zh: 浏览器Comp(Wei等,2025年)主要评价在开放网络上寻找的基于文本的信息,并为评估浏览能力提供参考. MMSearch(Jiang等,2024年)引入了图像文本查询并评价了查询重写,结果重排,信息汇总,以及端到端的答案生成. 浏览器Comp-VL(Geng等,2025年)将视觉识别与复杂的网络检索结合起来,要求代理基于图像中的实体进行多步搜索. 后来的基准更加强调视觉证据在搜索过程中的作用. MMSearch-Plus(Tao等,2026年)要求特工通过多轮图像文本检索来提取精细的视觉线索并验证相关事实和来源. VDR-Bench (Zeng等, 2026) 专注于根据文字线索和全图像匹配来减少快捷键. 它利用从图像区域取回,实体验证,以及多跳问题构建,对视觉搜索提出了更大的要求. VisBrowse-Bench (Zhang等,2026c)强调从网页上积极收集视觉信息,并评价跨图像的空间定位,属性识别和推理.

blocks.en: Other work further expands search structures and process evaluation. InterLV-Search ( Hou et al., 2026 ) examines how visual and textual evidence guide later search steps. Its open-web tasks include single-chain and multi-branch structures that involve comparing multiple objects or search paths. MM-BrowseComp ( Li et al., 2025 ) introduces multimodal evidence in both the input and the browsing process. It uses reasoning checklists to assess the completion of key steps. BrowseComp-V3 ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) covers alignment within image regions, integration across regions, and reasoning across images. It requires publicly searchable evidence and evaluates both final-answer accuracy and subgoal completion.
blocks.zh: 其他工作进一步扩大了搜索结构和流程评价. InterLV-Search(Hou等人,2026年)研究了视觉和文字证据如何指导以后的搜索步骤. 它的开放网任务包括单链和多分支结构,涉及比较多个对象或搜索路径. MM-BrowseComp(Li等,2025年)在输入和浏览过程中引入了多式证据. 它利用推理核对表评估关键步骤的完成情况。 浏览Comp-V3(Zhang等,2026a)涵盖图像区域内的对接,跨区域的整合,跨图像的推理. 它要求公开寻找证据并评价最后答复的准确性和次级目标的完成情况。

blocks.en: VisSearch-Bench further focuses on visual context management in search involving multiple images, multiple objects, and linked steps. Its tasks involve checking objects individually, combining results across a set, following visual clues, and distinguishing similar candidates. They also include using image structure together with external information to determine search targets. blocks.en: In VisSearch-Bench, we define visual context as the visual information involved in a task and its connections to object identities, external facts, and search targets. This information may come from input images or from images and webpages found during search. It includes object appearance and local features, as well as the order, positions, and connections of objects. Visual context management refers to organizing, connecting, and using this information to solve a task. This includes checking objects, comparing candidates, filtering results, and combining findings across steps. Based on these requirements, we organize VisSearch-Bench into five task categories. Each category emphasizes a main search requirement.

blocks.en:
1) Set-wise Visual Search. These tasks involve a clearly defined
set of objects. The set may come from a catalog specified in the question or
consist of objects shown in the input images. For each object, the agent
gathers and checks visual information. It then combines this information with
relevant facts to filter, compare, or summarize the results. The main challenge
is to cover all required objects and correctly link the information for each
one. Individual judgments must also remain consistent with the final summary. 2) Sequential Visual Search. These tasks involve multiple search
steps that depend on one another. An object, visual clue, or fact found in one
step guides later searches. For example, an agent may first identify an
artwork in an image, then find records about its artist, collection, or
exhibitions. Different steps may involve image understanding or text search.
The focus is on correctly connecting the information found across steps to
produce the required answer. 3) Hybrid Wide–Deep Search. These tasks combine sequential search
with search over a set of objects. Earlier findings can define the candidate
set to be checked. Filtering this set can then determine the target of the
next stage. For example, an agent may start from one work and identify its
award and year. It then examines images of works from the same award cycle
and selects those that meet the given conditions. Further searches gather
information about the selected works. The main challenge is to correctly
connect the search scope, individual judgments, and later targets across stages. 4) Competitive Visual Disambiguation. These tasks focus on visual
targets that are easily confused with other objects. Candidates may look
similar overall but differ in local shapes, textures, markings, or individual
parts. The agent compares the input image with retrieved images, descriptions,
and source records to verify the target’s identity. These tasks assess the
accuracy of visual detail matching and identity verification. 5) Visual-Structure-Guided Search. These tasks use object order, spatial
positions, or connections in an image to determine what to search for, in what
order, or where to search next. The agent combines this structural information
with external search results to locate objects, check conditions, and summarize
findings. The main challenge is to correctly connect image structure, object
identities, and search results, then use these connections to complete the task.

blocks.en:
Figure 3 summarizes our human-led construction
process with program-assisted verification. The process follows three
principles. Visual Indispensability means that critical visual
evidence cannot be replaced by the question text, webpage titles, captions,
OCR, or model knowledge. Visual Evidence Integration means that tasks
require agents to connect visual observations with object identities and external
information. Agents use these connections to guide searches, compare candidates,
filter objects, or combine results across steps. Public Solvability
and Auditability means that each task uses publicly retrievable evidence and
has verifiable critical states and a clear reference answer.
blocks.zh:
图3汇总了我们由人类主导的建筑
程序辅助核查。 过程遵循三个
原则。 视觉的不可缺少性意味着 关键的视觉
无法以问题文本、网页标题、标题、
OCR,或称模型知识. 视觉证据整合意味着任务
要求代理将视觉观测与对象身份和外部连接
资料。 特工们利用这些连接来指导搜索,比较候选人,
过滤对象,或组合跨步骤的结果。 公共溶解性
可审计性是指每项任务使用可公开检索的证据,
有可核查的临界状态和明确的参考答案。

blocks.en:
Annotators first select public sources that provide a bounded entity set,
reliable entity-image links, and independently verifiable factual fields. We
fix these sources before question writing. The reference answer therefore does
not depend on model search results or subjective judgments. Annotators then
organize the entities, images, factual fields, and candidate sets into a
traceable evidence structure. They apply the structural constraints of one
task family from Section 3.1 and write a question that hides the intermediate
nodes and final answer. Automated checks verify source accessibility, field
completeness, set coverage, answer recomputation, and possible shortcuts. We
discard tasks that bypass critical visual evidence or allow a shorter
unintended path. Human reviewers inspect every retained task.

blocks.en: VisSearch-Bench contains 204 tasks organized along two dimensions. The first dimension is search structure. It includes five task categories: Set-wise Visual Search, Sequential Visual Search, Hybrid Wide–Deep Search, Competitive Visual Disambiguation, and Visual-Structure-Guided Search. Each category emphasizes a different search requirement. Set-wise Visual Search contains 68 tasks, or 33.3% of the benchmark. Each of the other four families contains 34 tasks, or 16.7%. The second is content domain, with 7 primary domains and 25 secondary domains that measure coverage across knowledge areas and real-world settings.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We introduced VisSearch-Bench to evaluate visual context management in
long-horizon open-web search by multimodal agents. The benchmark contains
204 human-written tasks across five task categories. These tasks examine how
agents connect visual observations, object identities, and external information
to compare candidates, filter results, and combine findings across steps. Each
task includes traceable evidence sources, a reference answer, and scoring rules.
We use full-answer Accuracy to measure overall task completion. Process Score
measures the correctness and completeness of individual results and answers to
subquestions. Our evaluation covers 16 multimodal models. Search improves both
accuracy and Process Score in the paired comparisons, but the best system still
fully solves only 26.47% of the tasks. Model strengths also vary across task
categories and agent frameworks. Results on Set-wise Visual Search show a clear
gap between obtaining partially correct results and completing an entire task.
Verifying multiple objects and combining findings into complete, consistent
answers therefore remain important challenges. VisSearch-Bench provides a basis
for evaluating improvements in handling multiple images, linking clues across
steps, and producing complete answers.

blocks.en:
MMSearch is an early systematic benchmark for multimodal search engines.
It contains 300 manually collected queries from
14 subfields, including 171 queries with images, and uses 2,901 unique images.
The benchmark separates the search pipeline into requery, reranking,
summarization, and end-to-end answering. The component tasks reveal whether a
model can reformulate an image–text query and rank mixed search results,
while the end-to-end setting evaluates whether these operations lead to the
correct answer.

blocks.en: Accuracy User Prompt ⬇ You are a strict answer evaluator . Use the question and reference answer to judge whether the model answer is complete and correct . Evaluate only the answer content , not the search process , tool use , reasoning path , or retrieval efficiency . Award 1 if the entire answer is correct ; otherwise award 0. Do not give partial credit . [ Evaluation rules ] 1. Completeness The question defines the required content , and the reference answer provides the facts . Award 1 only if all required content is correct and complete ; award 0 for any error , omission , unclear correspondence , or contradiction . Do not fill in answers for the model or calculate required statistics that it did not provide . 2. Matching meaning Word - for - word matching is not required . Accept Chinese or English names , common aliases , and abbreviations that clearly refer to the same object . Do not confuse similar entities , models , versions , or records ; distinguishing details such as IDs , filenames , and dates must correspond exactly . 3. Lists and tables When a complete list or all matching items are required , do not allow missing , incorrect , or extra items ; each item ’ s attributes , category , and quantity must correspond correctly . Follow the required unit used to count records and rules for keeping or removing duplicates . Do not accept " the rest omitted " in place of required entries . Do not deduct points for a different order unless an order is required . 4. Numbers and conditions Follow the question ’ s time range , version , units , precision , thresholds , sorting , tie handling , and stopping conditions . Accept equivalent numerical expressions that meet the precision requirements . Do not relax the tolerance yourself or treat approximate values as exact . Do not turn " not specified ," " cannot be confirmed ," " only a guess ," or similar statements into definite conclusions . Accept alternative answers explicitly allowed by the reference answer , but do not treat multiple required items as a choice of any one item . 5. Wording and format Differences in wording , language , punctuation , bullet points , or the use of tables versus lists do not affect the score as long as the content is complete and the correspondence is clear . Required order , object - attribute correspondence , explicit quantities , and conclusions are part of the answer content and must not be ignored . Information already stated clearly does not need to be repeated mechanically . 6. Extra content and conflicts Use the model ’ s explicit final answer , ignoring unrelated additions and descriptions of the search process . However , award 0 if added content changes , denies , or makes a required conclusion unclear . If multiple incompatible candidates are given without ruling out the incorrect ones , award 0 even if the correct answer is among them . blocks.en: Process Score User Prompt (Table-Matching Example) ⬇ You are a strict table evaluator . Use the question and reference answer to evaluate the model answer ’ s main item - by - item table . Use row - matching F1 as the score , ranging from 0–1. Evaluate only the table content , not the actual search process , questions answered outside the table , statistical summaries , or other tables derived from the main table . [ Evaluation rules ] 1. Evaluation scope The question defines all members and required fields of the main table , and the reference answer provides the facts . Extra fields not requested by the question are not scored . 2. Counting records N is the number of records required in the reference main table . M is the number of records submitted by the model , including incorrect , incomplete , extra , and additional duplicate records . Count members using the unit specified by the question . Do not count headers , separator rows , or total rows . Treat split tables and lists with clear correspondence in the same way . 3. Correct matches Match objects one - to - one by identity . Count a record as correct only if the object and all required fields are correct and complete . Let C be the number of correct matches . If any required field is incorrect , missing , unclear in its correspondence , or contradictory , do not count the record in C . Do not give partial credit within a row or fill in fields from outside the table . Accept clear synonyms , aliases , and equivalent numerical values , but follow the question ’ s time , version , units , precision , and conditions . 4. Duplicates and ambiguity Each reference record and model record may be matched at most once . Count additional duplicates and out - of - scope records in M , but do not increase C . Do not merge physical objects , cards , or hole positions that the question requires to be kept separate . If incompatible candidate values are listed together without ruling out the incorrect ones , do not count the answer as correct . 5. Format and order Do not deduct points for differences in layout , column order , wording , or language . Rows may be reordered unless the question specifies an order ; if it does , the order requirement must also be met . Statistics or explanations outside the table do not affect this score . [ Calculation ] precision = C / M ; use 0 when M = 0. recall = C / N . score = 2 × C / ( M + N ). The reference table in this task is nonempty . N , M , and C are integers . Round all other results to four decimal places at the end . blocks.en: E.1 Dataset Composition

blocks.en:
VisSearch-Bench contains 204 human-authored tasks. Set-wise Visual Search
contains 68 tasks; each of the other four families contains 34. The benchmark
also covers seven primary and 25 secondary content domains. Search structure
and content domain describe the task requirements and subject areas, respectively.

blocks.en: E.3 Construction and Release Checks
blocks.zh: E.3 施工和放行检查

blocks.en:
Annotators use public sources to connect objects, images, and relevant facts.
For tasks involving a set of objects, they also define the required set.
Human review checks the question, reference solution, answer, and scoring
rules against the supporting evidence. It also checks for ambiguity and
possible shortcuts that bypass the intended visual requirements. Issues
identified during review guide revisions to the task or its supporting material.

blocks.en: Appendix F Qualitative Case Studies

blocks.en:
We present 17 representative trajectories across five task categories:
seven successful and ten failed runs from multiple models using ReAct or
DeerFlow. Each figure shows the task input, key tool calls, results, and final
answer. Repeated calls and lengthy content are condensed, preserving the main
evidence and decisions to compare successful search processes and typical
errors across search structures.

blocks.en: F.1 Set-wise Visual Search
blocks.zh: F.1 自动视觉搜索

blocks.en:
These tasks require full set coverage and a summary of individual judgments.
In Figure S1 , the agent crops and searches for all
12 museum objects. It uses official material and dimension records to assign
photography equipment and check category counts. The failed case finds an index
of 30 measured drawings but explicitly classifies only two
(Figure S2 ). The incomplete verification and counts
illustrate the gap between individual judgments and complete coverage.

这些任务需要全面覆盖,并需要一份个别判决摘要。
在图S1中,物剂作物和搜寻所有人
博物馆文物12件. 它使用官方材料和尺寸记录来指定

blocks.en: F.2 Sequential Visual Search
blocks.zh: F.2 顺序视觉搜索

blocks.en:
Search steps must correctly build on earlier findings. Successful cases
trace a building photograph to a step-free entrance
(Figure S3 ), and an anesthesia machine interface to safety
notices and suitable covers (Figure S4 ). One failed
case treats a similar text description as a map identification and searches
the wrong location (Figure S5 ). Another finds the
correct makerspace and detects conflicting information, yet reports the
wrong entity (Figure S6 ). Errors occur between search
steps and when combining results.
blocks.zh:
搜索步骤必须正确地以先前的调查结果为基础。 成功案例
追踪大楼照片到免步入口
(图S3),以及麻醉机接口的安全性
通知和适当的封面(图S4)。 一个失败
大小写将类似文字描述作为地图标识和搜索
错误的位置(图S5)。 另一个找到
正确的制造空间和发现相冲突的信息,但报告
错误的实体(图S6). 搜索之间发生错误
步骤和综合结果时。

blocks.en: F.3 Hybrid Wide–Deep Search
blocks.zh: F.3 混合广深搜索

blocks.en:
These tasks connect sequential search with candidate screening. The
successful case uses character relationships and voice-actor information
to identify candidate films, then compares poster backgrounds to find a
match (Figure S7 ). An incorrect motorcycle
identification confines broad search to the wrong category
(Figure S8 ). Incorrect judgments of backpack images
allow unsuitable candidates into later specification checks and ranking
(Figure S9 ).
blocks.zh:
这些任务将顺序搜索与候选人筛选联系起来。 这个
成功的案例使用字符关系和语音-代理信息
然后比较海报背景以找到
匹配(图 S7 )。 一辆不正确的摩托车
识别将搜索范围局限于错误的类别
(图S8). 对背包图像的错误判断
允许不合适的候选人参加以后的规格检查和排名
(图S9).

blocks.en: F.4 Competitive Visual Disambiguation
blocks.zh: F.4 竞争性视觉歧见

blocks.en:
These tasks distinguish similar candidates through visual details. The
successful case compares frames and plates in retrieved images, rejects its
initial match, and identifies a grain cutter
(Figure S10 ). Both failed searches retrieve the
correct candidate. One agent favors descriptions of a similar camera-accessory
model (Figure S11 ). The other retains its initial
interpretation of the components and misidentifies a photosynthometer
(Figure S12 ). Poor evidence selection can thus lead
to a wrong conclusion even after retrieving the correct candidate.
blocks.zh:
这些任务通过视觉细节区分出相类似的候选人. 这个
成功的案例比较取回图像中的帧和盘片,拒绝其
初始匹配, 并识别切粒器
(图S10). 两次搜索都失败 。
正确的候选人。 一个特工赞成描述一个相似的相机
(图S11). 其他保留其初始
解释组件并误用光合作用计
(图S12). 因此,证据选择不当可能导致
在找到正确的候选人后 也得出了错误的结论

blocks.en: F.5 Visual-Structure-Guided Search
blocks.zh: F.5 视觉-结构-指导搜索

blocks.en:
These tasks combine image order, positions, or connections with external
results to select the next target and determine when to stop. Successful
cases use uploader records to return to the image and select the next asset
(Figure S13 ), and check advisories in order until the
wind threshold is reached (Figure S14 ). Failures
include selecting the wrong next landform (Figure S15 ),
skipping a route stop (Figure S16 ), and linking the
wrong asset record to the starting ID (Figure S17 ).
These errors change the path defined by the image and misdirect later
searches and answers.
blocks.zh:
这些任务结合图像顺序、位置或与外部连接
结果选择下一个目标并确定何时停止。 成功
大小写使用上传器记录返回图像并选择下一个资产
(图S13),并核对咨询意见,直至
达到风能阈值(图S14.). 失败
包括选择错误的下一个地块(图S15),
跳过一个路由站(图S16),并连接
错误的资产记录到起始ID(图 S17 ).
这些错误改变由图像定义的路径, 并在稍后错误方向
搜索和答复。
